MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Glarks M3–M5 screw and nut assortment matches the sizes and practical fastening supplies I recently bought, so it fits my interests even though I would pass because it overlaps with what I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The printing filaments assume a project I have not shown any interest in; buying screws and magnetic hooks does not mean I own or use a 3D printer.",
    "Calipers could help measure hardware, but that possible usefulness does not give me an immediate reason to buy one.",
    "Wire connectors require a wiring task, and M6 bolts require a different size need from my recent M3–M5 purchase; neither need is apparent in my activity."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hardware purchases seem to have been taken as interest in a broad range of workshop supplies, even when those supplies serve unrelated tasks.",
    "Several filament recommendations repeat the same unsupported assumption; changing the material or color does not make printing supplies relevant to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My two recent magnetic hook purchases suggest a more immediate interest in magnetic hanging and mounting supplies than in printing materials.",
    "Exact fastener sizes matter to me; interest in M3–M5 screws does not establish a need for M6 bolts.",
    "A closely matching assortment may already be covered by my recent purchase. I rarely interact, so relevance alone is not enough without a current need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in fastening supplies but stretched it into unrelated workshop projects and missed that similar supplies may already meet my needs."
}
